description: TRO-stage order (2026-05-29) in a civil suit alleging Overnight Finance founder Maxim Ermilov diverted >$15M from treasury wallets; Circle — a named defendant — was directed to block USDC at the address that received ~12.4M USDC on 2026-05-11, which is Zama's Confidential USDC (cUSDC) wrapper contract. Circle blacklisted it 2026-05-30 01:08 UTC (tx 0x6e24a776…), freezing 12,606,386 USDC belonging to ~1,500 unrelated depositors. Lifted after the 2026-06-01 hearing (CU-TRG-0076).

authority: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California (Pitts, J.)
legal_basis: Text-only order (ECF 12, 2026-06-01), Newton AC/DC Fund, L.P. v. Ermilov, No. 5:26-cv-05055: 'For the reasons set forth on the record, any limitations imposed in the text order issued on May 29, 2026 [ECF 6] are hereby lifted.'
description: After the 2026-06-01 TRO hearing the court lifted the 2026-05-29 block directive; Circle unblacklisted Zama's cUSDC contract the same day (18:58 UTC), restoring access to ~12.5M USDC after a ~66-hour freeze. First litigated reversal of a civil-order Circle freeze in the dataset (a stipulated consent TRO followed on 2026-06-05 without a USDC block).
